executionPolicyNote: The first Windows PowerShell invocation without a process override was blocked by its execution policy. The successful test used process-only ExecutionPolicy Bypass; no persistent execution policy was changed.
limitations: AST checks verify named parameters and constant values against inspected source; they do not establish runtime binding or service behavior.
Preview sentinels cover named import, authentication, HTTP, mutation and filesystem commands; this is a conformance test, not a security sandbox.
Execute paths, Graph beta behavior, token handling, upload/commit, assignment, native UI/deferral, actual installer outcomes and endpoint detection remain untested.
The manifest remains illustrative and unbuilt; package/build identifiers, generated artifact hashes and endpoint acceptance are unresolved.
